description.value: The Snug Cafe is a breakfast café on Bowen Island, a small island community reached by ferry from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. OSM records it as a breakfast and coffee spot with outdoor seating and vegan options. It is one of a limited number of food and drink stops on the island, making it a potentially useful resupply point for cyclists riding Bowen's quiet roads.
